btn.clearCacheTitle: Clear server-side OCR / translation / inpaint cache
mask.confTitle: Box detection sensitivity threshold (higher — fewer false boxes)
mask.inpaintPadTitle: Inpaint context area expansion (dashed frame), % of bubble size
color.eyedropTitle: Eyedropper — pick a color from the page
color.bubbleTitle: Text color of this bubble (empty — global)
style.resetAll: Reset all bubble style overrides to global defaults
order.toolsTitle: Bubble reading order (continuous across all pages)
order.label: Order:
order.strategyTitle: Reading order strategy (shared for all pages, or per-page — see checkbox)
order.individualTitle: Enables individual order ONLY for this page. Unchecked — edits the shared order for all pages.
order.numberTitle: Click bubbles in reading order (manual order for this page)
order.clickHint: Click bubbles in reading order. Click again to remove a number. "Done" applies it.
font.label: Font:
font.globalTitle: Default translation font (filtered by target language)
font.globalMarginTitle: Default text margin from bubble edges (% per side)
font.globalValignTitle: Default vertical alignment of the text block
font.gearTitle: Text defaults: size, margin, alignment, color
font.bubbleTitle: Font family of this bubble (empty — same as global from the header)
size.bubbleTitle: Text size in pixels. ↺ — same as global
margin.bubbleTitle: Margin from bubble edges, % per side. ↺ — same as global
valign.bubbleTitle: Vertical alignment of the text block. ↺ — same as global
slant.bubbleTitle: Slant of the whole text line, degrees (0 = horizontal)
font.globalVerticalTitle: Default vertical text (top-to-bottom, columns right-to-left). Enable for Japanese manga.
vertical.bubbleTitle: Vertical text (top-to-bottom) — for narrow bubbles. Not available for Arabic/Hebrew. Double-click to reset to global.
vertical.label: Vertical
stroke.label: Outline
stroke.bubbleToggleTitle: Text outline on/off. Double-click to reset to global.
stroke.bubbleColorTitle: Outline color (inherits global when not set)
translate.label: Translate:
translate.allTitle: Translate all pages in the queue
ctx.passTitle: Improves translation quality — the model sees conversation history. Off: each request is stateless, faster and cheaper.
ctx.windowTitle: How many previous pages are passed as context for "Translate all". 0 — no limit (backend caps it).
ctx.pagesTitle: How many previous pages are passed when editing one page. 0 — no context.
ctx.bubblesTitle: How many preceding bubbles are passed when editing one bubble. 0 — no context.
texts.styleToggle: Text settings (font, size, margin, alignment, slant, color)
texts.heading: Text and translation ({count})
texts.emptyHint: Translate a page and the text will appear here for editing.
texts.noClean: Translate the page first (no cleaned background)
empty.hint: Upload pages or a PDF to start.
bp.title: Box
bp.selectHint: Select a box on the image to adjust its settings.
bp.hint: A gray parameter = default from the header. Touch it — it becomes individual; ↺ resets it back.
bp.clearBrushInfo: Erase manual mask edits (brush/eraser) within this box
bp.clearBrushTitle: Erase brush edits in this box
clear.confirmText: Clear the whole queue? All uploaded pages, boxes, masks and translations will be deleted — progress cannot be restored.
console.title: Console
tip.expand: Expands the painted mask around text strokes by a fraction of the stroke thickness — to fully cover letters and their anti-aliased edges. This is not the inpaint context.
tip.grow: Additionally expands the whole mask outward by N pixels on top of the "stroke-based expansion". Helps clean up the halo around the text.
tip.inset: Shrink the box inward by N pixels before searching for text, so the bubble's own outline isn't caught.
tip.minArea: Connected pixel spots smaller than this size are treated as noise and skipped. Lower — catches small dots, dashes, furigana.
tip.centerPriority: Discard elements lying mostly near the box edges (usually the bubble outline, not text).
tip.centerRadius: Size of the box's central zone for "center priority". Lower — edge elements are discarded more strictly.
tip.inpaintPad: Size of the context area around the bubble that inpaint sees (dashed frame). Fraction of bubble size. Does not affect the fill mask itself.
queue.toggleTitle: Collapse/expand the page queue (frees up canvas space)
queue.label: Queue ({count})
redetect.confirm: Re-detection will replace all boxes on the current page (including manual edits). Continue?
